text:
Priya: quick follow-up from the safetensors warmup RFC — proposing a progressive header-decrypt overlay for encrypted shards so we can start warmup earlier without pulling whole shard into memory.
Kyle: sounds interesting. can you sketch the flow?
Priya: root idea: fetch a small authenticated header (<=4KB) that contains chunk map + encryption metadata, verify signature, then start streaming decrypt of chunks we need. header-first lets us prioritize layers for KV cache warmup.
Ari: how does this interact with manifestless bundles? we already have people needing to hotstart without full manifests.
Priya: two modes: 1) manifest-present: header contains chunk index + prefetch hints. 2) manifestless: header is minimal, we fallback to small-range GETs using range requests to discover chunk offsets. still header-first, just lighter.
Lina: what about KMS calls? per-shard KMS on every header could be heavy.
Priya: plan is to cache envelope keys in an ephemeral key-cache with lease TTL (e.g., 5m). only the initial header signature verification hits KMS once per lease. chunk decrypt uses envelope key locally.
Mason: risk: replay or stale key usage during rolling key rotations. need a tombstone or key-version in header.
Priya: yep header will include key_version and a small key_revocation bitmap pointer. verification fails if revoked. fallback path: if header verification fails, treat shard as opaque and stream-copy into a quarantine bucket for offline repair.
Kyle: perf tradeoffs: extra 4KB request + verify <-> earlier warmup wins. have we measured latency impact on cold-start?
Priya: rough numbers from local PoC: header GET ~= 6ms (same-region), signature verify <=2ms, then first-chunk decrypt ~4ms. overall ~12ms before we can warm a layer, vs ~80ms to fetch full shard. good for short-sequence workloads.
Ari: how do we signal prioritized layers? we already support warmup hints in request metadata. header should include a layer_priority array with stable identifiers.
Priya: yes — header schema (draft):
```
magic: RWDH
schema: safetensors-header-v1
enc: AEAD-KMS
key_version: 2026-03-01
chunk_map_offset: 4096
chunk_map_len: 8192
layer_priority: ["embed","ln_0","attn_kv"]
prefetch_hint: {count:2, strategy:"sequential"}
```
Lina: config knobs? we should allow operators to pick decrypt mode: streaming vs bulk, and warmup aggressiveness.
Priya: agree. suggested config:
```
warmup:
  mode: progressive
  decrypt: streaming
  prefetch: 2
  key_cache_ttl_seconds: 300
```
Mason: failure modes: partial decrypt failure mid-hotstart -> must gracefully evict partially decrypted pages and retry. ensure we don't expose corrupted KV cache state.
Priya: add idempotent checkpointing: each chunk decrypt writes to a temporary workspace with checksum. only promote to live cache after verify.
Kyle: ops question: telemetry. we need metrics: header_fetch_ms, header_verify_ms, chunk_decrypt_ms, kms_calls, fallback_count.
Priya: noted. we'll add to console and route traces to per-model dashboard.
Ari: API boundary: loader should expose an async iterator API so runtime can stream decrypted tensor segments into execution without blocking. that keeps runtime decoupled from transport/encryption.
Priya: exactly. prototype API: `async for chunk in loader.stream(tensor_id): apply_to_kv(chunk)` small and composable.
Lina: any compatibility concerns with existing safetensors indexes? header should be optional; loader must handle legacy shards without header.
Priya: loader will detect header magic and fall back to legacy path when absent. we'll include auto-conversion tooling to bake headers into existing bundles.
Mason: timeline and next steps?
Priya: immediate plan: 1) spec header schema + key versioning (this week) 2) implement PoC loader with header-first + key cache (2 weeks) 3) run canary on internal dev models (1 week) 4) roll out gradual default for hosted (metric-gated).
Kyle: +1 to timeline. assign owners?
Priya: I'll own spec + PoC. @Kyle will own telemetry + rollout gating. @Ari to help with loader API and manifestless fallback. Lina/Mason help on ops/rotations and failure modes.
deploy-bot: Created task RED-ML-1042: "progressive-header-decrypt loader PoC" assigned to Priya, due in 14 days.
Lina: :thumbsup:
Ari: small nit — include a single ASCII-encoded sync token in header to simplify recovery across restarts.
Priya: good call, will add.
Kyle: sounds good. let's sync after the spec is posted in the RFC doc and add a short demo to the next eng-ml meeting.
Priya: will post spec in docs and link here when ready. thanks all.
